slides.title: About 40,000 from Ethiopia now in Moyale, Kenya
slides.body: Kenya's rights commission calls for urgent aid.

slides.title: Where people are staying
slides.body: More than 15,000 are in eight temporary shelters, including churches and schools. Over 20,000 are with relatives and friends (KNCHR, Oct 27).

slides.title: Figures are rising
slides.body: Kenya Red Cross reported more than 14,000 at the weekend. Counts differ between agencies and are not independently verified.

slides.title: What is needed
slides.body: Food, clean water, shelter, sanitation and health care, including maternal care. The commission warns crowding could raise disease risk.

slides.title: Protect people seeking safety. Keep aid flowing.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Anadolu Agency; Citizen Digital · Oct 27, 2026
